title: In the subway: lines, transfers and exits
summary: Ask station staff which line to take, where to change, and which exit to use.

variants.en: Which station are you going to?

rephrase.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò dào nǎ yí zhàn?
rephrase.en: Which stop do you want to ride to?

choices.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào gāi zuò jǐ hào xiàn.
choices.en: I'm not sure which line to take

train-line.speaker: Station staff
train-line.zh: 去火车站坐一号线，在对面上车，三站就到。
train-line.pinyin: Qù huǒchē zhàn zuò yī hào xiàn, zài duìmiàn shàng chē, sān zhàn jiù dào.
train-line.en: For the train station take Line 1 from the opposite platform. It's three stops.

rephrase.zh: 你要坐一号线，在另一边上车，坐三站。
rephrase.pinyin: Nǐ yào zuò yī hào xiàn, zài lìng yìbiān shàng chē, zuò sān zhàn.
rephrase.en: Take Line 1, board on the other side, and ride three stops.

choices.en: Where do I buy a ticket?
The opposite side? Do I need to cross over?

choices.zh: 一号线，三站。明白了，谢谢！
choices.pinyin: Yī hào xiàn, sān zhàn. Míngbai le, xièxie!
choices.en: Line 1, three stops. Got it, thanks!

ticket.speaker: Station staff
ticket.zh: 那边有自动售票机，也可以直接扫码进站。
ticket.pinyin: Nàbian yǒu zìdòng shòupiàojī, yě kěyǐ zhíjiē sǎo mǎ jìn zhàn.
ticket.en: There are ticket machines over there, or you can scan a code to go straight in.

choices.en: Okay, I'll go buy a ticket

choices.pinyin: Nǐ néng jiāo wǒ zěnme yòng ma?
choices.en: Could you show me how to use it?

opposite.speaker: Station staff
opposite.zh: 对，从这个楼梯下去，走到另一边的站台。
opposite.pinyin: Duì, cóng zhège lóutī xiàqu, zǒu dào lìng yìbiān de zhàntái.
opposite.en: Yes. Go down these stairs and walk to the platform on the other side.

line-q.speaker: Station staff
line-q.en: Which station are you going to?

choices.pinyin: Jiù shì zhège zhàn, nǐ kàn.
choices.en: This station — have a look (showing your phone)

transfer.speaker: Station staff
transfer.zh: 先坐二号线，到人民广场换八号线。
transfer.pinyin: Xiān zuò èr hào xiàn, dào Rénmín Guǎngchǎng huàn bā hào xiàn.
transfer.en: Take Line 2 first, then change to Line 8 at People's Square.

variants.en: You change trains once on the way.

rephrase.zh: 你要换一次车：二号线坐到人民广场，然后坐八号线。
rephrase.pinyin: Nǐ yào huàn yí cì chē: èr hào xiàn zuò dào Rénmín Guǎngchǎng, ránhòu zuò bā hào xiàn.
rephrase.en: You change once: Line 2 to People's Square, then Line 8.

choices.zh: 在人民广场换八号线，对吗？
choices.pinyin: Zài Rénmín Guǎngchǎng huàn bā hào xiàn, duì ma?
choices.en: Change to Line 8 at People's Square, right?

choices.pinyin: Shì bā hào xiàn háishi sì hào xiàn?

stops.speaker: Station staff
stops.zh: 一共五站，大概十五分钟。
stops.pinyin: Yígòng wǔ zhàn, dàgài shíwǔ fēnzhōng.
stops.en: Five stops in all — about fifteen minutes.

choices.pinyin: Míngbai le, bā hào xiàn. Xièxie!

airport.speaker: Station staff
airport.zh: 去机场坐二号线，一直坐到终点站。
airport.pinyin: Qù jīchǎng zuò èr hào xiàn, yìzhí zuò dào zhōngdiǎn zhàn.
airport.en: For the airport take Line 2 all the way to the last stop.

exit.speaker: Station staff
exit.zh: 你要哪个出口？这里有八个出口。
exit.pinyin: Nǐ yào nǎge chūkǒu? Zhèlǐ yǒu bā ge chūkǒu.
exit.en: Which exit do you want? There are eight here.

rephrase.pinyin: Nǐ yào cóng jǐ hào chūkǒu chūqu?
rephrase.en: Which numbered exit do you want to leave by?

choices.zh: 我要去人民公园，哪个出口近？
choices.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Rénmín Gōngyuán, nǎge chūkǒu jìn?
choices.en: I'm going to People's Park — which exit is closest?

choices.zh: 我也不知道，我要去这个地址。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào, wǒ yào qù zhège dìzhǐ.
choices.en: I don't know — I'm going to this address

address.speaker: Station staff
address.zh: 我看看……这个地址走二号口出去，然后左转。
address.pinyin: Wǒ kànkan... zhège dìzhǐ zǒu èr hào kǒu chūqu, ránhòu zuǒ zhuǎn.
address.en: Let me see... for this address, leave by Exit 2 and turn left.

choices.pinyin: Èr hào kǒu, chūqu zuǒ zhuǎn. Xièxie!

choices.en: Is it still far after I exit?

ride-end.speaker: Station staff
ride-end.en: You're welcome — take care on the way!
ride-end.outcome: You know which train to take.

machine-end.speaker: Station staff
machine-end.zh: 可以。先选英文，再选站名，最后付钱就行。
machine-end.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Xiān xuǎn Yīngwén, zài xuǎn zhànmíng, zuìhòu fù qián jiù xíng.
machine-end.en: Sure. Choose English first, then the station, then pay.
machine-end.outcome: They walk you through the ticket machine.

exit-4-end.speaker: Station staff
exit-4-end.zh: 四号口往那边走，看到楼梯上去就是。
exit-4-end.pinyin: Sì hào kǒu wǎng nàbian zǒu, kàndào lóutī shàngqu jiù shì.
exit-4-end.en: Exit 4 is that way — go up when you see the stairs.

exit-park-end.speaker: Station staff
exit-park-end.zh: 人民公园走十一号口最近，跟着指示牌走。
exit-park-end.pinyin: Rénmín Gōngyuán zǒu shíyī hào kǒu zuì jìn, gēnzhe zhǐshìpái zǒu.
exit-park-end.en: Exit 11 is closest to People's Park. Follow the signs.
exit-park-end.outcome: You follow the signs to Exit 11.

welcome-end.speaker: Station staff
welcome-end.outcome: You leave by Exit 2 and turn left.

address-far-end.speaker: Station staff
address-far-end.zh: 不远，出去走五分钟就到。
address-far-end.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, chūqu zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
address-far-end.en: Not far — a five-minute walk once you're out.
address-far-end.outcome: Your destination is five minutes from Exit 2.
